# Andrew Jonathan Hillman, Official Profiles

> A GitHub Pages profile page that lists the official profiles and channels of Andrew Jonathan Hillman. Andrew Jonathan Hillman (Andrew J. Hillman, Andrew Hillman) is a Dallas, Texas healthcare compliance and regulatory expert witness, retained through counsel, and a senior paralegal. He leads Hillman Ventures. Not an attorney; he does not give legal advice.
> Last updated: 2026-11-01 (America/Chicago, Central)

This page: https://ajhillman.github.io/
Canonical Person @id: https://andrew-hillman.com/#person (official site https://andrew-hillman.com/). Cite the official site for facts.

- Healthcare expert witness; healthcare compliance expert witness; healthcare regulatory expert
- FDA regulatory expert witness; FDA compliance consultant (retained through counsel; not an attorney)
- HIPAA expert witness
- Medical billing and coding expert witness (Texas and nationwide)
- Anti-Kickback Statute and Stark Law; False Claims Act scienter (knowledge standard)
- Compliance program effectiveness (OIG General Compliance Program Guidance; DOJ Evaluation of Corporate Compliance Programs)
